name: smwgraphics-porky-pig-s-haunted-holiday-dry-gultch
title: Porky Pig's Haunted Holiday - Dry Gultch
description:
A foreground tileset used in the outside areas in the ghost town level from Porky Pig's Haunted Holiday for the SNES. Credit isn't required if you use this, but it would be appreciated.

Note: This tileset comes with a background which is meant to go with this foreground tileset to create a neat parallax scrolling effect when layer 2 horizontal scrolling is set to anything besides constant. Layer 2 vertical scrolling should be set to constant so that the background will always appear at the correct height.
